meta.name: Pac-12 Channel
meta.description:
Your home for Pac-12 sports! Watch classic encores from your favorite sports, like football and basketball, and exclusive, behind-the-scenes stories that showcase the heart and soul of Pac-12 student-athletes, coaches and legends.

Shows: Basketball in 30, Football, Football in 30, Pac-12 Football Preview, (LIVE) Bronco Studios
Available on: Samsung TV Plus
